cases.title: Connected providers resolve authorization evidence through NATS and apply live revocation
cases.description: A connected provider resolves an unknown caller through exact NATS KV reads, serves cache hits without external I/O, receives revocation through its watch, becomes unready on NATS disconnect, recreates watches and initial state before readiness returns, stays ready on a quiet registry, and cannot write registry values with its issued JWT.

given: a live Trellis runtime
a connected provider with initialized manifest and revocation watch state
when: an unknown caller invokes the provider twice
the caller context is revoked while both runtimes remain connected
the service NATS connection disconnects and reconnects
the registry stays quiet for longer than the removed staleness interval
then: the first request performs one coalesced context and evidence resolution through NATS KV
the second request performs zero HTTP, NATS registry, Auth RPC, or SQLite I/O
the provider's issued JWT can read but cannot write the registry
the revocation watch denies the next request without context refresh or expiry
the NATS disconnect makes the provider unready immediately
reconnect recreates watches and initial state before readiness returns
a quiet registry never recreates watches or becomes unhealthy

typescript.testName: authorization-registry.provider-cache resolves over NATS and applies live revocation
